news.headline: Kahn Swick & Foti, LLC Initiates Investigation into Bloom Energy Corporation
news.summary: Law firm Kahn Swick & Foti, LLC has announced an investigation into the officers and directors of Bloom Energy Corporation regarding potential breaches of fiduciary duty.

news.headline: BofA Securities Adjusts Robinhood Markets PT to $151 From $156, Maintains Buy Rating
news.summary: BofA Securities has lowered its price target for Robinhood Markets, Inc. while maintaining a Buy rating on the stock.

news.headline: Louisiana Court Issues Temporary Restraining Order Against Robinhood and Other Event Contract Operators
news.summary: A Louisiana judge has issued a temporary restraining order prohibiting Robinhood and other platforms from offering event contracts in the state without a gaming license.

news.headline: Micron, Samsung, and SK Hynix Fail to Dismiss DRAM Price-Fixing Lawsuit
news.summary: A court has denied a motion by Micron Technology, Samsung, and SK Hynix to dismiss a lawsuit alleging price-fixing in the DRAM market.

news.headline: Marvell Technology and Penguin Solutions Collaborate on AI Memory Demands
news.summary: Marvell Technology and Penguin Solutions have announced a partnership to integrate Marvell's memory-expansion controllers and optical interconnect technology into Penguin's AI infrastructure systems.

news.headline: Arete Adjusts Price Target on Marvell Technology to $323 From $300
news.summary: Analyst firm Arete has revised its price target for Marvell Technology, Inc. upward to $323 from the previous target of $300.

news.headline: Bernstein Initiates Coverage on Dell Technologies with Outperform Rating
news.summary: Bernstein analysts issued an "Outperform" rating for Dell Technologies, citing robust growth in its enterprise AI business and a high-quality order backlog.

news.headline: Morgan Stanley Adjusts Price Target on Dell Technologies to $403 From $511
news.summary: Morgan Stanley has lowered its price target for Dell Technologies to $403 from $511.

news.headline: Citigroup Adjusts Price Target on Dell Technologies to $550 From $600
news.summary: Citigroup has revised its price target for Dell Technologies, lowering it from $600 to $550.

news.headline: Corning Secures Major Optical Glass Order and Prepayments from Nvidia
news.summary: Corning has received a significant order for optical glass from Nvidia, supported by multi-billion-dollar plant prepayments to facilitate the expansion of manufacturing operations.
